description: This Kotlin source file defines a Retrofit API interface for accessing various content categories (trending, continue watching, action, family, comedy, horror, drama) in an Android TV application. It includes a singleton factory method for creating the API service with configured HTTP client and JSON converter.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Retrofit API interface providing methods for fetching different categories of shows such as trending, continue watching, action, family, comedy, horror, and drama. It includes a companion object with a factory method to instantiate the service.

methods.name: getTrending
methods.description: Suspending function to fetch a list of trending shows as ShowDto objects.

methods.name: getContinueWatching
methods.description: Suspending function to fetch shows that are to be continued watching.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve action genre shows.

methods.name: getFamily
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve family genre shows.

methods.name: getComedy
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve comedy genre shows.

methods.name: getHorror
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve horror genre shows.

methods.name: getDrama
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve drama genre shows.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ApiService with configured base URL, HTTP client, and JSON converter.
